MGDG / HexDG / MHDG; class-intrinsic O 10; the sugar comes from the class token not from the chains; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1 and 2.3
MGDG with an O- chain (LipidBlast EtherMGDG; MGDG-O suffix with unmarked chains); class-intrinsic O 9; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1
SMGDG; the vocabulary holds only the ether version so the plain SMGDG spelling is rejected (class_not_in_vocab); class-intrinsic O 12; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1 and 2.3
DGDG / DHDG; DGMG is MG-Hex2 not this class; class-intrinsic O 15; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1
DGDG with an O- chain (LipidBlast; DGDG-O suffix); class-intrinsic O 14; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1
DGGA / GlcADG; class-intrinsic O 11; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1
ADGGA = DGGA whose sugar carries a third acyl chain; L1 gets no extra ;O for that acyl (class-intrinsic O 12); no ether version in the vocabulary; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1 and 4.2
1-O-alkyl or 1-O-alkenyl diglyceride (O- or P- chain; -O suffix leaves the ether chain unmarked); class-intrinsic O 4; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1 and 2.2
SQDG; no ether version in the vocabulary (SQDG-O and SQDG with an O- chain are rejected); class-intrinsic O 12; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1
diacylglyceryl carboxyhydroxymethylcholine; class-intrinsic O 8; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1
LDGCC; the lyso state is triggered by the class token only (single chain); class-intrinsic O 7; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1 and 2.2
diacylglyceryl trimethyl-beta-alanine; same head mass as DGTS so the PNNL spelling DGTSA stays ambiguous and is rejected; class-intrinsic O 7; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1 and 9
diacylglyceryl trimethylhomoserine; class-intrinsic O 7; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1
LDGTS / MGTS; lyso state triggered by the class token; class-intrinsic O 6; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1
monoacylglycerol; single chain so L1 L2 L3 coincide; both zero-chain placeholders of the three-slot spelling are dropped; class-intrinsic O 4; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1 and 5.3
MGMG (one acyl chain on a hexose glycerol); class-intrinsic O 9; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1
DGMG (one acyl chain on a dihexosyl glycerol); not DGDG; class-intrinsic O 14; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1
1-O-alkyl or 1-O-alkenyl glycerol; the single chain is the ether chain whenever the class is ether; class-intrinsic O 3; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1
SQMG / LSQMG; class-intrinsic O 11; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1
SQMG with an O- chain (single LIPID MAPS entry); class-intrinsic O 10; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1
triacylglycerol; class-intrinsic O 6; a three-slot spelling with a zero-chain placeholder is a diacylglycerol and is rejected (chain_count); evidence fam_gl.md 2.1 and 5.3
one ether chain plus two acyl chains (O- P- plasmanyl- plasmenyl- prefixes or the -O suffix); class-intrinsic O 5; evidence fam_gl.md 2.1
